claims.rationale: All 10 tools print version stamp on startup/--version. Format: weizigo-<tool> <sha>[-dirty] built <date> zig <ver>. Build-time generation via tools/gen-version.sh → src/version.zig (gitignored). Dirty flag works: dirty tree yields -dirty suffix.
oracle-v2-build writes artifacts into untracked/vNN/ with manifest.json. Version counter in untracked/VERSION auto-increments. Scheme: version directory holds artifact + manifest + binaries.
verify-battery JSON header includes battery_version with full version stamp. docs/infra/versioning.md documents the scheme.

notes: Built and tested: zig build succeeds, all 10 tools run with correct stamp. verify-battery --version works. oracle-v2-build version directories + manifest not yet exercised end-to-end (requires full 4x4 solve). src/version.zig added to .gitignore (never committed stale).
